Career Fieldnotes

Comparing cybersecurity and data analytics through original employer descriptions, qualifications, and learning priorities.

Read the researchRepository
Read case study

The question

Which direction fits the skills I am developing as an Information Systems major, and how is AI changing the work?

My role & assistance

I supplied my major, career interests, assignment requirements, and burgundy design preference. ChatGPT assisted with employer discovery, drafting, implementation, and checks. This draft does not claim independent coding or personal verification that has not occurred.

Approach & decisions

Organize three original employer descriptions into evidence, requirements, and interpretation. Compare the two directions using the same questions. Keep personal reflection in Canvas and public evidence on the website.

Current result

A browsable research site, source repository, and continuing project record exist. Employer descriptions were reviewed during creation on November 11, 2026. They are experienced-role examples, not proof of typical entry-level requirements.

Evidence

Employer records and dates · Initial source change · Project record

Next iteration

Complete a small log investigation and a public-data analysis, then compare the experience. These exercises, human partner review, and a final career choice are unfinished.

PanicType

A typing racer concept where mistakes trigger optional scares. The current work is the research site and implementation plan.

Research siteRepository
Read case study

The question

Can an optional horror response make a short typing race engaging without interrupting it too often?

My role & assistance

I proposed a typing race with scares after mistakes. ChatGPT assisted with research, scope, architecture proposals, documentation, and the static research site. A working game is not claimed.

Approach & decisions

Bound the first version to one computer pacer rather than live multiplayer. Plan account access, a saved owned race result, private history, and account maintenance. Compare every-error scares with a cooldown; preserve a quiet fallback.

Current result

The repository contains a research site, November 19 SPEC, project record, and check receipts. Flask, SQLite, ownership checks, scoring tests, and the pattern experiment are proposed work; application behavior and user-study results are not yet verified.

Evidence

SPEC source · Project record · Checks and limits

Next iteration

Build and test the future account-to-saved-result journey, including persistence and two-user isolation. Run the scare and pattern comparisons later. The Creative Project plan-only exception does not replace this portfolio draft.
